project_name: Erdős 726: upper-half prime-residue reciprocal sums and Mertens reductions

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedPrimes
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedPrimes (B n : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun B n => Finset.filter (fun p => Dvd.dvd p n) (Erdos726.oddPrimeRange B)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedSum (B n : Nat) : Real :=
  fun B n => Finset.sum (Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedPrimes B n) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimes
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimes (B n : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun B n => Finset.filter (fun p => LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p)) (Erdos726.primeRange B)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimeSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimeSum (B n : Nat) : Real :=
  fun B n => Finset.sum (Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimes B n) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.oddPrimeRange
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.oddPrimeRange (n : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n => Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (Eq (HMod.hMod p 2) 1)) (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTail
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTail (n K : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n K => Finset.filter (fun p => LE.le (HAdd.hAdd K 1) (HDiv.hDiv n p)) (Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimes n)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTailSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTailSum (n K : Nat) : Real :=
  fun n K => Finset.sum (Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTail n K) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTail
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTail (n K : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n K => Finset.filter (fun p => LE.le (HAdd.hAdd K 1) (HDiv.hDiv n p)) (Erdos726.upperHalfPrimes n)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTailSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTailSum (n K : Nat) : Real :=
  fun n K => Finset.sum (Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTail n K) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.largePrimeWindowMajorant
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.largePrimeWindowMajorant (n K : Nat) (δ : Real) : Real :=
  fun n K δ =>
  HAdd.hAdd
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (↑K) (HAdd.hAdd (↑K) 2)) ↑n)
          (HDiv.hDiv 1 (Real.log ↑(HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd K 1)))))
        (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (HAdd.hAdd (↑K) 2)) (HMul.hMul (Real.log ↑(HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd K 1))) (Real.log ↑n))))
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 4 ↑K) δ))
    (HDiv.hDiv ↑(HSub.hSub (Erdos726.primeCount n) (Erdos726.primeCount (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd K 1)))) ↑n)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.primeRange
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.primeRange (n : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n => Finset.filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p) (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.primeCount
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.primeCount (m : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun m => Finset.card (Erdos726.primeRange m)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.pntRemainder
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.pntRemainder (M : Nat → Real) (m : Nat) : Real :=
  fun M m => HSub.hSub (↑(Erdos726.primeCount m)) (M m)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimes
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimes (n : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n =>
  Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (Not (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p))))
    (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimeSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimeSum (n : Nat) : Real :=
  fun n => Finset.sum (Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimes n) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p

Erdos726.upperHalfPrimeSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos726.upperHalfPrimeSum (n : Nat) : Real :=

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.variants.mertens_estimate
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos726.variants.mertens_estimate :
  Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
    (fun n => Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p) (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1))) fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p)
    fun n => Real.log (Real.log ↑n)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.asymptotic_iff_discrepancy_isLittleO
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos726.asymptotic_iff_discrepancy_isLittleO :
  Iff
    (Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
      (fun n =>
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p)))
            (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1)))
          fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p)
      fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) 2)
    (Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop
      (fun n => HSub.hSub (Erdos726.upperHalfPrimeSum n) (Erdos726.lowerComplementPrimeSum n)) fun n =>
      Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.iff_smallPrimeTail_of_log_add_two_bounds
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos726.iff_smallPrimeTail_of_log_add_two_bounds (K : Nat → Nat) (δ : Nat → Real) (N₀ : Nat)
  (hδ : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 0 (δ n))
  (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 2 (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hK : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1) (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hR :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ →
        ∀ (m : Nat),
          LE.le m n →
            LE.le (abs (Erdos726.pntRemainder (fun m => HDiv.hDiv (↑m) (Real.log ↑m)) m)) (HMul.hMul (δ n) ↑m))
  (hmaj :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Erdos726.largePrimeWindowMajorant n (K n) (δ n)) (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  Iff
    (Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
      (fun n =>
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p)))
            (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1)))
          fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p)
      fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) 2)
    (Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTailSum n (K n)) (Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTailSum n (K n)))
          (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.of_smallPrimeTail_and_log_add_two_bounds
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos726.of_smallPrimeTail_and_log_add_two_bounds (K : Nat → Nat) (δ : Nat → Real) (N₀ : Nat)
  (hδ : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 0 (δ n))
  (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 2 (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hK : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1) (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hR :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ →
        ∀ (m : Nat),
          LE.le m n →
            LE.le (abs (Erdos726.pntRemainder (fun m => HDiv.hDiv (↑m) (Real.log ↑m)) m)) (HMul.hMul (δ n) ↑m))
  (hmaj :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Erdos726.largePrimeWindowMajorant n (K n) (δ n)) (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (htail :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Erdos726.upperSmallPrimeTailSum n (K n)) (Erdos726.lowerSmallPrimeTailSum n (K n)))
          (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
    (fun n =>
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p)))
          (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1)))
        fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p)
    fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) 2

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos726.of_modular_reflection_and_log_add_two_bounds
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos726.of_modular_reflection_and_log_add_two_bounds (K M : Nat → Nat) (δ : Nat → Real) (N₀ : Nat)
  (hδ : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 0 (δ n))
  (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le 2 (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hK : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1) (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)))
  (hle : ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → LE.le n (M n))
  (hM :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ →
        ∀ (p : Nat), Membership.mem (Erdos726.oddPrimeRange (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1))) p → Dvd.dvd p (M n))
  (hR :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ →
        ∀ (m : Nat),
          LE.le m n →
            LE.le (abs (Erdos726.pntRemainder (fun m => HDiv.hDiv (↑m) (Real.log ↑m)) m)) (HMul.hMul (δ n) ↑m))
  (hmaj :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Erdos726.largePrimeWindowMajorant n (K n) (δ n)) (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hrefl :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        HDiv.hDiv
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (abs
                (HSub.hSub (Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimeSum (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)) n)
                  (Erdos726.upperBoundedPrimeSum (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)) (HSub.hSub (M n) n))))
              (Erdos726.dividingOddBoundedSum (HDiv.hDiv n (HAdd.hAdd (K n) 1)) n))
            (1 / 2))
          (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
    (fun n =>
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.filter (fun p => And (Nat.Prime p) (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv ↑p ↑2) ↑(HMod.hMod n p)))
          (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd n 1)))
        fun p => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑p)
    fun n => HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) 2
